source_identification: Mike Usher, MATH 8210 Fall 2011 lecture notes, a two-part smooth-manifold/differential-geometry course text. The fresh baseline covers coordinate-free multivariable calculus, partitions of unity, smooth manifolds, tangent/vector-field formalisms, differential forms and de Rham theory, then submanifolds, vector bundles/tubular neighborhoods, vector fields and flows, Lie derivatives, Cartan's formula, and related material.
exercise_structure: Thirteen numbered Exercise headings are integrated into the exposition (Exercises 1.2, 1.3, 2.11, 3.4, 3.11, 3.14, 3.15, 3.22, 4.4, 4.11, 4.12, 4.20, and 4.24). They are subordinate course-note exercises rather than a standalone exam/problem sheet, so no exercise collection is manufactured.
